summary: BitFuFu Inc., a Singapore-based Bitcoin miner, filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, reporting unaudited July 2026 production and operational metrics. The filing discloses holdings of 1,314 BTC (down from 1,671 BTC), production of 112 BTC, and managed hashrate of 14.2 EH/s. The decrease in holdings was due to advance payments for future hashrate capacity in August. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special-situation event is described; it is a routine operational update. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors.
